LEVA-BASHB(1)             General Commands Manual             LEVA-BASHB(1)

NAME
     leva-bashb - sample shell builtins, bash layout

DESCRIPTION
     A tiny page used to test builtin extraction.

SHELL BUILTIN COMMANDS
     Unless stated otherwise each builtin returns zero on success.
     It returns a non-zero value when it fails.

     : [arguments]
             Does nothing beyond expanding the arguments.  Returns zero.
     cd [-L|-P] [dir]
             Changes the current directory to dir.  Then it updates the
             variables that track the old and new place.

             -L      Follow symbolic links.
                     This is the default.
             -P      Use the physical layout and skip links.
     read [-r] [name ...]
             Reads one line from standard input and splits it into the names.
     test expr
     [ expr ]
             Evaluates a conditional expression and returns its result.
     read [-s] name
             A second, later description of read that must be ignored.

SEE ALSO
     leva-zshb(1)
